claims.harm: placing last block announcement state in CNode leaks net_processing eviction logic into net
claims.quote: I don't think this belongs in `CNode`. It is used in our outbound eviction logic which is part of net processing and it isn't used in net at all

claims.harm: calling duration count directly is fragile and would change log output silently if the chrono type changes
claims.quote: This is fragile, because when the type of `oldest_block_announcement` changes, the log output will change, too, without a compile error. It would be better to use `Ticks` or `TicksSinceEpoch`.
claims.settled_by_quote: Force-pushed to implement review suggestion to use `TicksSinceEpoch()` (thanks!)

claims.harm: incorrect comparison logic when checking for oldest block announcement timestamp among eviction candidates
claims.quote: This looks wrong to me, i think it should be: if (state->m_last_block_announcement < oldest_block_announcement.value_or(NodeSeconds::max()) || (state->m_last_block_announcement == *oldest_block_announcement && pnode->GetId() > worst_peer))
claims.settled_by_quote: Thanks, good catch! I force-pushed to fix this in a slightly different way that seems more clear to me.
